test_run: test the python module by running inference on a CO3D dataset with a pretrained ViewDiff model
run_sliding_window_generation: run sliding window generation to produce novel views with cross-frame attention conditioning
setup_run_environment: setup run environment by creating output directories, tensorboard writer, and saving config
process_batch_inference: process a single batch through the diffusion pipeline to generate novel view images
combine_batches: combine known condition images with new generated images into a single batch for cross-frame attention
